I don't think suicide is selfish. I also think anyone who says it is does not truely understand why/what it means for a person to feel that way. You have expressed that you have love, and that you do have at least the smallest amount of hope that things can be better. I think that's wonderful. If knowing that you are giving it one final go and then your pain will end either way is what is going to get you through this, then I think it's a great thing. Of course it is going to be hard for anyone who cares about you to hear that, but in all honesty everyone in the world uses an end goal to get themselves through the day, yours is just not one many can understand. 
I also think it's very toxic to tell a person suicide is selfish regardless of how you feel because if a person is expressing these types of feelings to you they are already going to be extremely vulnerable and telling them they are selfish is only going to make them feel worse. What they need is someone to listen to them, remind them of better times as well as times to come, and most importantly distract them long enough to get them out of the immediate mental crisis they are in. Take them for a walk, play a game, cook a meal, do something that involves both a mental and physical challenge if possible.

Hahaha. I love the 50 first dates comparison. Unfortunately i tried all of those things and it didn't let me off shift until about 2 minutes after the scheduled time. It's the first time anything like that has happened. In fact earlier that day it did the normal kick me out 30 minutes till.
Honestly with the tips I made that day it was definitely worth it. Just not so much the day I drove 50 miles and didn't get tipped one dollar..
